data_status: All campaign telemetry, faults and QC values in this app are synthetic. No raw manufacturing campaign dataset has been obtained or fitted.

sources.title: Manstein et al. (2021), High density bioprocessing of human pluripotent stem cells by metabolic control and in silico modeling
sources.access: Full article XML retrieved from the Europe PMC primary-literature mirror. A supplementary PDF link was identified; its detailed contents were not audited.
sources.finding: The study connects growth, perfusion and metabolic control in stirred suspension culture. Its availability statement directs dataset requests to the authors. No synchronized sensor/action/QC export was obtained in this audit.
sources.use: Qualitative process structure only. The implemented equations, coefficients, campaign length and fault histories are illustrative and are not a reproduction of this study.
sources.license: Article CC BY-NC 4.0; no article or supplementary files redistributed.

sources.title: ISSCR research standards, Section 2: Pluripotency and the Undifferentiated State
sources.finding: Undifferentiated-state marker expression alone does not demonstrate functional pluripotency.
sources.use: The simulated phenotype result is labelled as an undifferentiated-state measurement.

sources.title: FDA research overview: replication-associated DNA damage in iPSCs
sources.finding: The overview discusses replication-associated DNA damage as a separate concern in iPSC biology.
sources.use: Genomic evidence remains independent of metabolic recovery. This page does not define the app's invented QC thresholds.
